verdict.rationale: Bento documents the attribution metadata: `init()` accepts `user_id`, `session_id` and `tags` that apply to every span, spans can be tagged with feature flags and experiment IDs, and `convo_id` ties runs together. Separately, it reports cost per run out of the box. But no evidence shows cost or usage actually aggregated or broken down by those user, session or feature dimensions, so the linkage is only implied. Missing for 10: documented cost/usage breakdowns grouped by user, session or feature metadata; token/usage attribution reporting; independent or hands-on corroboration.
